First time fine. No menu change for 2 years or more.
Jun 2020
This was my go-to restaurant for breakfast and for the both of us, the occasional lunch and dinner. It's conveniently located on Thao Dien, the heart of the food district of District 2.

However of late, my visits have been reduced to the point of being far between. Not surprising, for their menu hasn't changed one iota for the past few years. True, some of the foods served are good, my highly recommended is the fish pot pie, but their breakfast menu is way out of date, and so is pretty much of the other menu items.

Their saving grace is a list of "specials" which is usually for main cources, reserved for lunch and dinner.

So my recommendation is only for first-timers or you'll run out of options pretty quick.
